root_idea.summary: The root centers on the eye as the organ of seeing and looking.
root_idea.development: From the eye, the lexicon develops by resemblance and association into sight, watchfulness, observation, springs and visible flowing water, spies, visible essence, excellence, and selected or prominent things.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Presented under the normalized feminine singular citation form عَيْنَاءُ, whose Quranic plural is عِينٌ.
Presented under the normalized adjective/noun citation form مَعِينٌ.

senses.definition: The eye, the organ of sight.
senses.usage_conditions: Used literally of human and other animal eyes, in singular, dual, and plural forms.

senses.definition: A spring or source of flowing water.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of water that wells or runs from the earth; the Quran also uses the plural for springs and sources.

senses.definition: Sight, watchful view, or protective oversight.
senses.usage_conditions: In constructions such as بِأَعْيُنِنَا and عَلَى عَيْنِي, it denotes being before someone's eyes, under observation, care, or protection; it may also mean openly or in view.

senses.definition: Large- and beautiful-eyed; a large-eyed or beautiful-eyed woman or companion.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form عِينٌ is the plural feminine description, used of female companions characterized by strikingly large or beautiful eyes.

senses.definition: Flowing and visible at the surface; water or another liquid running openly like a spring or stream.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of accessible, apparent flowing water and, in Quranic descriptions of Paradise, of a flowing drink or liquid.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hit or hurt someone in the eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A literal physical striking of the eye.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The evil eye; a glance believed to cause harm or illness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also denotes the act or effect of striking someone or property with such a glance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act as a spy or scout, or to send a spy to obtain information.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the relevant person, people, or destination as the object of reconnaissance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To flow, said of tears or water; of a well, to contain abundant water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The water usage is a lexical extension from the spring or source.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reach a spring or water while digging.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a digger reaching the underground source or water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be wide-eyed or large in the black of the eye; width or largeness of the eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The quality is the basis of the adjective أَعْيَنُ and its feminine and plural forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bore, perforate, or pierce a pearl.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The action is understood as making an eye-like opening.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pour water into a new leather water-skin so that its stitch-holes close by swelling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized leather-working use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To individuate, specify, distinguish, appoint, or assign something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes specifying something in words, assigning property or an obligation, singling out a person, and specifying an intention.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tell someone to his face about his faults or vices.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A direct, face-to-face reproach.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stir up or conduct conflict between parties.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression for setting war or conflict in motion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become beautiful and bright, and to blossom, said of trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical use applied to the appearance of flourishing trees.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A credit-sale arrangement involving a deferred sale and a subsequent cash purchase, or sale on deferred payment generally.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources record differing technical descriptions and legal assessments of bayʿ al-ʿīnah.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To write or form the letter ع.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A graphic or scribal use of the noun عين for the letter's name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To see directly with one's eyes; to view, face, or confront.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verbal noun عِيَانٌ or مُعَايَنَةٌ denotes direct ocular or face-to-face witnessing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dealing in buying and selling for ready money.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized commercial sense associated with عَيْنٌ as ready cash.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be evil-eyed or to have an allegedly harmful eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived verbal expression describing the person possessing the harmful glance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To look at or try to see someone or something, and to see it with certainty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This derived verb can describe deliberate visual examination or certain perception.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become confounded or perplexed through shame, and to wait or act deliberately in order to cast the evil eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare reported use combining embarrassment, hesitation, and the evil-eye action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become thin, worn, perforated, or lacerated, said of a skin, water-skin, or camel's foot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The skin develops eye-like thin circles or holes; the camel-foot use refers to worn or blistered soles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become clear, distinct, individuated, specified, or assigned.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes becoming particularized or incumbent on a particular person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take the choice or best part of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of selecting the best portion of property or another thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To buy something on credit for payment at a future time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A commercial use associated with the technical term عِينَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ocular presence, immediacy, certainty, or purposeful attention in idiomatic expressions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes expressions meaning eye to eye, in one's direct view, deliberately and earnestly, or near before one.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The eye of a constellation, especially a named star or pair of stars.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional astronomical naming use based on the eye of an animal or figure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Names for an ox-eye plant, certain dark grapes or raisins, and certain black plums.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are separate named objects linked by resemblance to animal eyes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stone known as cat's-eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional name based on visual resemblance; the cited source gives it no practical utility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The eye or opening of a needle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A shape-based extension from the eye as an organ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small perforation, thin circle, or defect in leather or a water-skin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The defect is named for its eye-like form and may allow water to escape.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The small hollow or cavity at the knee joint.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Each knee is described as having two such hollows, likened to eye sockets.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The small leather receptacle in which bullets or pellets are placed for shooting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A shape-based technical object name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The opening from which water issues from a pipe, well, or other conduit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Distinct from the spring itself: the term can denote the outlet or aperture through which water pours.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Abundant well-water, a drop of water, or metaphorically life, good, or provision.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are extended uses of the water-source meaning; the cited poetic expression uses عَيْنُ المَاءِ for life or access to good.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The eye or bud of a tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A shape-based botanical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sprouting herbage or newly emerged pasture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the idiom that the land has looked with one or two eyes when vegetation appears.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A spy, watcher, observer, or scout.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may be masculine or feminine and denotes one who watches a people or seeks information.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A discoverer or revealer of news or hidden information.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of seeing what is concealed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A look, view, or ocular sight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes direct sight or an act of looking, distinct from the physical eye itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person's aspect, outward appearance, or visible evidence of inner qualities.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The external appearance may be treated as evidence sufficient to assess the person or thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person, any individual, a group, or the people of a house, town, or country.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A synecdochic use in which an eye stands for a person or the people who possess eyes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lord, chief, commander, or eminent and noble person; the notable members of a people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural أَعْيَانٌ also denotes prominent or high-born individuals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Full siblings sharing both father and mother.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural use of أَعْيَانُ الإِخْوَةِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The choice, best, most excellent, or highly prized part of a thing, goods, animals, or property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning may also describe something excellent or highly valued.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Property that is present, ready, at hand, or within reach.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Contrasted with property that is absent or owed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ready money or cash, as opposed to debt or deferred payment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression عَيْنٌ غَيْرُ دَيْنٍ explicitly contrasts cash with debt.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A present or immediately available gift.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A gift that is present in hand, sometimes contrasted with an unavailable or deferred one.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A coined gold coin, especially a dinar; by extension, coined gold.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source distinguishes it from coined silver and also records a broader gold meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A half-dāniq deducted from seven dinars.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized monetary term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Gold in general.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension based on gold's excellence among metals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sun, its disk, or its rays.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer to the solar disk, the sun itself, or the beams that affect the eye.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing's self, essence, substance, person, or very identity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Often used in بِعَيْنِهِ and related constructions to mean itself, exactly that one, or in its very essence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Certain, sure, or manifest information.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression for information that penetrates or is unmistakably clear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Certain and manifest knowledge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from what is directly seen and therefore known with certainty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Might or strength.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Health and safety.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative meaning, distinct from sight and physical protection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thirst.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare reported meaning, also attributed to the related form غَيْنٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The form or outward shape of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the visible organ and appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The direction of the qiblah, or clouds and rain coming from that direction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Regional usage varies: the term may denote the direction itself, its right-hand side, or clouds and rain arriving from it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rain continuing for several days without clearing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A weather term derived from the direction and rain usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Usury or interest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative commercial use, also found in the expression عَيْنُ الرِّبَا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An unevenness or slight inclination in a balance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word denotes the excess that makes one pan or side outweigh the other.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The tongue or central pointer of a balance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical component name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Either pan of a balance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical use distinct from the balance's pointer or its unevenness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small compartment or partition in a chest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized object name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A receptacle or container for dry herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare technical meaning associated with a مِحَشَّة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Either half or side of a pair of saddle-bags.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized object name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain small bird with a yellow belly and dark green or ash-colored back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical bird name; the source compares its size with a collared turtle-dove.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Arabic letter ع.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical alphabetic use, said to be one of the guttural letters.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The middle radical of a triliteral word.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A grammatical and morphological technical term using the traditional فَعَلَ template.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The numerical value seventy in the abjad letter calculation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical numerical use of the letter name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The part surrounding the eye of a ewe.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Comparable to the human eyelid or eye socket area.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Goodly or attractive appearance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a garment or other thing with a pleasing appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An accession or reinforcement of the strength or forces of war.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized figurative use, likened to additional milk collecting in an udder.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plant found in al-Andalus, said to attenuate bodily humors when cooked with figs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specific botanical name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Clear, evident, manifest, open, or publicly visible.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Derived from direct ocular seeing and used adjectivally or adverbially.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An iron part of a plough, including the ploughshare or a ring associated with it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The exact component varies among the cited descriptions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Two divining lines, birds, or arrows used in augury or gaming.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The phrase refers to objects from whose movements, flight, or results information was sought.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who strikes others with the evil eye; evil-eyed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The forms are agent or descriptive derivatives of the evil-eye usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Quick to weep.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare adjectival use applied to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A water-skin with thin eye-like defects, one that leaks, or a worn water-skin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources also record a dialectal or disputed use meaning new; the defect and leakage senses are the explicit lexical branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Flowing water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use derived from عَيْنُ المَاءِ, the water-source.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A party of companions who see the speaker or are themselves seen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in a construction describing people whose eyes are directed toward or perceived by the speaker.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or situation in which the enemy's eyes are watching someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional construction focused on being exposed to observation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The herds or flocks, together with their herders, belonging to a specified group.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized collective use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wild bull or wild cow, named for its large or beautiful eyes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine عَيْنَاءُ is used of the wild cow; the sources differ over whether أَعْيَنُ should be used of the wild bull.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sheep or goat with black eyes and a contrastingly white body, or the reverse according to one report.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A marked eye-and-body coloration in livestock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A good or beautiful word, saying, or expression.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use likening speech to a woman beautiful and wide-eyed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An epithet for verse or rhyme reported as penetrating or effective.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The exact interpretation is uncertain in the cited lexicographic discussion; it is not treated as a Quranic meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A reported epithet for a dark or greenish land or a repeatedly used water-bucket.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source presents the land interpretation as conjectural and suggests that the bucket interpretation may better fit the surrounding explanation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place in which people are seen or known to be present.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place characterized by visible presence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of alighting, residence, or abode.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a settlement or location where a group lodges.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A spring or source with a continuously increasing or replenished flow of water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialization of the spring meaning emphasizing continued increase.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment figured with eye-like designs or small square patterns resembling animal eyes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A textile description based on visual patterning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bull marked between the eyes, or marked with black-and-white eye-like spots.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reports explain the name through the animal's eyes or eye-like markings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Locusts whose white and red coloring becomes visible after the outer covering is removed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A distinct, particular, or specially specified purpose or intention.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial use derived from specifying or particularizing an intention.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An explorer sent ahead of a people to seek pasture, water, rain locations, and news.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized scout who surveys conditions before the group travels.

cautions: The normalized public headword عَيْنَاءُ represents the Quranic plural form عِينٌ; the QAC lemma is retained in form accounting.
مَعِينٌ is treated here as belonging to the supplied root, although the lexical evidence records a dispute over whether its initial م is original or derived.
The noun عَيْنٌ has many broader Classical Arabic extensions; Quranic senses are kept separate from those non-Quranic branches.
